name: Yonaga-sama
source:
The protagonist, Furukawa Inosuke, is staying in 'Yonaga Village' for a few days as part of his thesis research. In that village, there existed an ominous legend about the deity of longevity the villagers worship: 'Yonaga-sama'.

Hiroshi of unknown nationality, a yandere little girl, some weird old men, a suspicious widow...

As he shouts 'p*op' over and over together with his good friend Kogure, Inosuke approaches the truth hiding in Yonaga Village...!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18844]Freem![/url]]
translation:
为了进行大学毕业论文研究，主角古川亥之介将在“Yonaga村”停留几天。村民们供奉着一位名叫“Yonaga大人”的长寿之神，而围绕这位神明，却流传着不祥的传说。

国籍不明的Hiroshi、病娇小女孩、奇怪的老头们、可疑的寡妇……

亥之介一边与损友小暮不停大喊“大●”，一边逐渐接近Yonaga村隐藏的真相……！

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18844]Freem![/url]]
